question:
Study the following bar graph and answer the question that follows.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d260d36b27e7efc3d6adb60eb224a86d1620a2dfd64e0c0df99664243982b88f.png] 

In which year was the number of accounts approximately 15% of the total number of accounts in all the years.
solution:
Total number of accounts = 73.45 + 104.76 + 138.50 + 182.06

⇒ 498.77

15% of 498.77

⇒ 74.81

**∴ In 2010, the number of accounts approximately 15% of the total number of accounts in all the years .**
